blocks.text: Filipino pageant fans woke up to news that the 76th Miss Universe edition will be hosted in Vietnam next year, but a faction of the international organization has claimed that the 2027 host country will be announced later. The Miss Universe Organization (MUO) issued a statement on the pageant’s official Instagram account and new corporate website to dispute the announcement made on the “Miss Universe” Facebook page claiming that the next competition will be held in Vietnam. “The Miss Universe Organization wishes to clarify that Vietnam has not been designated as the host country for the 76th Miss Universe Competition in […]...
